$comment: The rule-pack format (FLR-T-6.3, rules/README.md): a pack's manifest on disk, rules/<name>/pack.json. tools/build-pack.ts assembles it and the pack's rule files into the one pack object an evaluator reads (pack.schema.json, spec/rules chapter 2), which stays the single definition of that object; what this file adds beyond it travels in the built pack's extras.packFormat.
title: Floorspec rule-pack manifest
description: A pack's name, version, licence and attribution, the jurisdiction and editions it addresses, its maintainers and domains, and its declared coverage.

license.title: Licence
license.description: Every pack is CC BY 4.0 (FLR-ADR-011, spec/rules 2.3).

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: The attribution CC BY 4.0 asks a reuser to give: who made the pack, its name and version, and where it is published.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction scope
jurisdiction.description: Where the pack is meant to apply, in words: "United States: model codes as published, before local amendment".

editions.title: Editions covered
editions.description: Every code edition a rule or coverage entry of the pack cites.

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: True for an example or test pack that cites only synthetic codes (TEST-...) and no real requirement; such a pack is left out of the repository's coverage matrix.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: The subject areas the coverage matrix summarises by: egress, room sizes, receptacles.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: spec/rules 2.4's coverage entries, each with the domain it belongs to and, for what is not checked yet for want of data, the deferred measures it needs (spec/rules 4.8).

coverageEntry.title: Coverage entry on disk
coverageEntry.description: spec/rules 2.4's entry, plus its domain and the deferred measures it waits on.

needs.title: Deferred measures needed
needs.description: The deferred measures (spec/rules 4.8) whose data would let the pack check what it does not yet.
